cinderfall.incomplete: ambiguous as written: legendary-reload's own text implies Trick Reload normally caps a free reload at once/turn ("supersedes Trick Reload's once-per-turn limit"), which would make this a clean SKIP (action-cost-to-free, no secondary effect) if that reading is correct. But taken literally, the card as written states no cost reduction to build against. Flagged in Open Questions rather than assumed — defaulting to INCOMPLETE per the discipline of not assuming unstated intent. Pure action-cost-to-free conversion with no secondary numeric effect -- matches the pre-confirmed absence directly (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/barbarian/level-14/vengeful-strike.json and .../shared-class-feats/level-2/quick-draw.json, both rules: []).
